### Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or enhancement.

### Problem / Motivation

Is your feature request related to a specific project milestone or problem?
(e.g., "We need to support range checks on transaction dates as required by KPI-01")

### Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like to see implemented.

### Affected Components & Roles

- [ ] Data Pipeline Engineering (DE)
- [ ] Data Quality Validation (DQ)
- [ ] Orchestration & Platform Reliability (OR)
- [ ] Observability & Telemetry (OB)
- [ ] Testing & Quality Assurance (QA)
- [ ] DevOps & Infrastructure (DO)

### Alternative Solutions Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you considered, and why they were rejected.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Clear requirement 1
- [ ] Clear requirement 2
- [ ] Test cases covering the new behavior
